en.title: JR Tokai Boosts Wheelchair Access; Advocacy, Reports, and Accessibility Guides Highlight Daily Disability News
en.summary: JR Tokai announced wheelchair boarding assistance for visually impaired passengers on Shinkansen, improving rail access. Meanwhile, advocates pushed for barrier‑free upgrades at Tarumi Station, a new report revealed 30% of abusers of disabled people are facility staff, and an ADHD‑focused color system highlighted over 17,000 Spotify accessibility issues. A commuter’s love for a station lacking barrier‑free access underscores ongoing gaps.

highlights.title: JR Tokai provides wheelchair boarding assistance for visually impaired passengers
Advocacy for Barrier-Free Improvements at Tarumi Station
Report Shows 30% of Abusers of Disabled People Are Facility Staff
ADHD‑focused color system design highlights Spotify accessibility issues
Fan expresses love for station lacking barrier‑free access

zh-TW.title: JR東海增設輪椅登車協助；倡議、報告與無障礙指南聚焦殘障議題
zh-TW.summary: JR東海宣布為視障乘客提供輪椅登車協助，提升新幹線無障礙服務。同時，多摩利站的無障礙改善倡議獲得推進，日本犯罪白皮書報告顯示30%殘障人士施虐者為設施人員，且ADHD專注色彩系統揭示Spotify超過17,000項無障礙問題。一位通勤者對缺乏無障礙設施車站的喜愛凸顯持續的無障礙缺口。

highlights.title: JR東海提供視障乘客輪椅登車協助
多摩利站無障礙改善倡議
報告顯示30%的殘障人士施虐者為設施人員
ADHD 專注色彩系統設計凸顯 Spotify 無障礙問題
粉絲表達對缺乏無障礙設施車站的喜愛
